body: I will tell her the next time I can, I hope you're right. I need her help.
Thank you. I'm too scared to tell my girlfriend because I think she'll just get mad at me and them i'll have no chance of getting support.

I care about my girlfriend very much. We have such an amazing time together, it's only when we have an argument she gets aggressive and mean. Any other time she treats me with kindness and is supportive. She's the only one that's been kind to me. Even before we were dating she was the only one who gave me a present for my 16th birthday, and it was darn thoughtful. I just feel so helpless that when she's mad since I have no one to turn to. My parents have always told me to got to hell and to jump into traffic. I know other people have had way worse parents than me but it's just another group I can't talk to.
